title: The Relic Thieves
text: Thieves have robbed a pilgrims' caravan of its relic and fled into the hills, leaving one guard dead in the road. The pilgrims kneel in the dust, tearing their clothes and begging for help. The tracks are still fresh.

options.label: Chase the thieves into the hills to win back what was stolen.

outcomes.text: They fight for it and lose. The pilgrims sing your names.

options.label: The sharpest tracks them to their hideout to catch them unawares.

outcomes.text: The lot of them are asleep. You take back the relic, along with their loot.

options.label: The Leader buys the relic from the thieves and keeps it for the House.

outcomes.text: The pilgrims will never know who has it.
